text: Need a way to implement disaster recovery of agent session ending suddenly, which can happen when using a remote server or if the power gets shut off.  This may involve a combination of agent harness improvements and backlogit tooling.  Need to perform adequate research and analysis to understand what this feature entails.

Add a stash.jsonl file to .backlogit/archive/ that collects each stash entry as it is staged and pulled into a shipment after deliberation. This preserves a durable record of all prior stash entries, including their original text, priority, kind, linked deliberation ID, and the harvested artifact ID. Currently, removed stash entries disappear entirely from stash.jsonl with no historical trace.

Constrain `backlogit_export_command_map` to `.backlogit/` or ratify a formal exception. `WriteCommandMap` resolves paths against the repo root instead of `.backlogit`, so the MCP/CLI export can write anywhere in the repository and bypass the normal write-only containment boundary.

Fix `backlogit_adopt_item` to atomically rewrite IDs and rename files. Adoption currently changes only `parent_id`, leaving the old hierarchical ID, Markdown filename, and log filenames in place even though the orphaned-task compound doc calls for full ID rewrite, file rename, manifest updates, and index sync.

Add stash hygiene to the Stage workflow. Stage agent guidance still lacks a standard stale-stash pruning step even though stash entries now expose `age_days` and support `stash remove` and `stash edit`; update the agent protocol and refresh the stale compound doc so future agents stop falling back to raw `stash.jsonl` edits.

Tighten query-gate and section-write correctness. The SQL gate rejects valid read-only queries when semicolons appear inside string literals, and `writeSectionsToFile` treats every `WriteSections` error as 'section not found' and appends new markers, which can duplicate or corrupt sections on structural parse failures.

Fix workflow edge-case invariants in stash harvest and status blocking. `HarvestStashByPriority` reads the batch before locking and then harvests entries one by one, leaving a TOCTOU window for spurious failures, and `TerminalStatuses` omits `rejected`, so rejecting a parent can bypass the child-blocking guard that applies to other terminal outcomes.
Internal lifecycle hooks for validation, cascade, and enforcement
External system hooks with prioritized notification push support for Slack, Teams, and webhooks

Fix instructions files that still reference index.db instead of backlogit.db: constitution.instructions.md, backlogit-sql-schema.instructions.md, go-mcp-server.instructions.md. These are teaching/reference artifacts that need careful review. Follow-up from BC78CBDA partial coverage in shipment 012-S.
